plan.lesson.title: Today's lesson
plan.lesson.doneNext: {course}: done for today. Day {day} is ready whenever you are.
plan.lesson.next: {course}, day {day}: {lesson}. Then your own mistakes on it.
plan.train.clearPractice: Queue's clear. Practice ahead, it still counts.
plan.train.allDrilled: Every position drilled. Play a game and we'll find fresh material.
plan.train.nothingYet: Nothing to train yet. Play a game and we'll find fresh material.
plan.openings.idleDetail: Your opening exits show up here once your games are checked.
plan.openings.nothingDue: Nothing due. Practice ahead, it still counts.
plan.endgames.idleDetail: Endgames you let slip in your games show up here.
plan.endgames.nothingDue: Nothing due. Replay a saved endgame.
plan.play.locked: Unlocks when your plan is done.
plan.play.detail: New blunders from your games land in your queue.
streak.freezeUsed_one: A streak freeze saved your {days}-day streak.
streak.freezeEarned: {days} days in a row. You earned a streak freeze: miss a day and it keeps your streak alive.
commitment.saveError: Could not save your commitment. Try again in a moment.
commitment.smallerPlans: Smaller plans you actually finish beat big ones you skip.
language.title: Language
language.help: Spanish and Portuguese cover the main screens; the rest stays in English for now.
profile.prefSaveError: Could not save this preference. Try again.
profile.syncPrefsHelp: New games come in every time you sign in, and when you click Sync now. These settings decide which games count.
profile.dailyCommitmentHelp: Sets today's plan on the dashboard. Changes save instantly.
profile.trainingHelp: What each position shows you. The pictures show the current setting; changes save instantly.
profile.pref.hideInfo.title: Hide extra info when solving
profile.pref.hideInfo.desc: Keeps the move you played, its refutation and the win chances hidden until you've moved, like a real game.
profile.pref.rawEvals.title: Show raw engine evals
profile.pref.rawEvals.desc: Adds the engine number (+1.2) next to the win chances.
profile.pref.showAnswer.title: Show the answer after a miss
profile.pref.showAnswer.desc: Draws the best move and adds the solution line. Also in the gear on the board.
profile.pref.autoplay.title: Autoplay the lines after a miss
profile.pref.autoplay.desc: Plays out why your move fails, then the solution when the answer is on. Tap the board to stop.
profile.pref.sounds.title: Play sounds
profile.pref.sounds.desc: Move, capture and check sounds, plus a cue when you solve, miss or unlock something.
profile.look.help: Your avatar shows in the sidebar and on leaderboards. New themes, pieces and avatar extras unlock as you climb your path. Changes save instantly, except the avatar, which saves when you press Use this avatar.
profile.look.themeNote: The landing and sign-in pages keep the default look.
profile.community.help: Leaderboards show your Lichess or Chess.com username (or your display name) and your avatar, never your email. The weekly top 5 also appears on the public homepage, by chess username only.
profile.pref.leaderboards.title: Show me on leaderboards
profile.pref.leaderboards.desc: Turn off to drop off every board (the homepage one within an hour). Your own stats and achievements stay.
profile.backfill.title: Game data backfill
profile.backfill.help: Re-parse stored PGNs to extract opening codes, ratings, and clock data so insight cards can use them.
profile.signOutHelp: End your session on this device.
gameType.timeControlsHelp: Leave all unchecked to include every time control.
events.title: Events near you
events.help: Over-the-board tournaments in your state show on your dashboard and in your Sunday email.
supporter.title: Supporter
supporter.pastDue: Your last payment didn't go through. Stripe will try again; you can update your card below.
supporter.endsOn: Your support ends on {date}. You keep the Early Supporter flair after that.
supporter.thanksNext: Thank you for supporting PatternChess. $5 a month, next payment {date}.
supporter.thanks: Thank you for supporting PatternChess. $5 a month.
supporter.grantUntil: You have Supporter perks until {date}, thanks to the friends you invited.
supporter.earlyThanks: Thank you for supporting PatternChess. Your Early Supporter flair stays yours.
supporter.pitch: PatternChess is free. If it helps your chess, $5 a month keeps it running.
supporter.grantAdds: Your invite rewards add perks until {date}.
email.title: Email
email.saveError: Could not save this setting. Try again in a moment.
email.remindersHelp: Sent to {email}: a nudge on days you have training due and a weekly progress report. Every email also has a one-click unsubscribe.
email.enterNew: Enter the new address. We'll send a confirmation link to it.
email.lichessNoEmail: You signed in with Lichess, which doesn't share an email address. Add one to get a nudge on days you have training due and a weekly progress report.
email.addressError: Couldn't save that address. Check it and try again.
email.pending: We'll send a confirmation link to {email} within the hour. Reminders start once you click it. Nothing there? Check your spam folder, or {change}.
rank.label: Rank
rank.help: Ranks advance as you master positions: {cycles} spaced cycles at ≥80% recall.
